data_description.stop: Name of the bus stop to search for, for example Rådhusparken. You can also enter a stop ID.

data_description.direction: Short name such as north or west. It is used in the entity IDs, for example sensor.jlt_bus_1_north_departure_1.

manual.title: Enter line and destination
manual.description: No upcoming departures were found from {stop}, so enter the line and destination manually.

data_description.destination: As shown on jlt.se, for example Huskvarna via Centrum-Elmia.
data_description.direction: Short name such as north or west. It is used in the entity IDs, for example sensor.jlt_bus_1_north_departure_1.

abort.already_configured: This line and destination is already configured for the stop.

data_description.too_late_threshold: Minutes it takes to get to the bus stop.
data_description.number_of_departures: Number of upcoming departures to create entities for.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch departures from jlt.se.
